ayahs.tr: Ta, Ha.

ayahs.ar: مَا͏ٓ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْقُرْاٰنَ لِتَشْقٰٓي ۝٢ۙ
ayahs.tr: We have not sent down to you the Qur'an that you be distressed

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا تَذْكِرَةً لِّمَنْ يَّخْشٰي ۝٣ۙ
ayahs.tr: But only as a reminder for those who fear [Allah] -

ayahs.ar: تَنْزِيْلًا مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ الْاَرْضَ وَالسَّمٰوٰتِ الْعُلٰي ۝٤ؕ
ayahs.tr: A revelation from He who created the earth and highest heavens,

ayahs.ar: اَلرَّحْمٰنُ عَلَي الْعَرْشِ اسْتَوٰي ۝٥
ayahs.tr: The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established.

ayahs.ar: لَهٗ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِي الْاَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحْتَ الثَّرٰي ۝٦
ayahs.tr: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنْ تَجْهَرْ بِالْقَوْلِ فَاِنَّهٗ يَعْلَمُ السِّرَّ وَاَخْفٰي ۝٧
ayahs.tr: And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden.

ayahs.ar: اَللّٰهُ لَا͏ٓ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَؕ لَهُ الْاَسْمَا࢜ءُ الْحُسْنٰي ۝٨
ayahs.tr: Allah - there is no deity except Him. To Him belong the best names.

ayahs.ar: وَهَلْ اَتٰىكَ حَدِيْثُ مُوْسٰي ۝٩ۘ
ayahs.tr: And has the story of Moses reached you? -

ayahs.ar: اِذْ رَاٰ نَارًا فَقَالَ لِاَهْلِهِ امْكُثُوْٓا اِنِّيْٓ اٰنَسْتُ نَارًا لَّعَلِّيْٓ اٰتِيْكُمْ مِّنْهَا بِقَبَسٍ اَوْ اَجِدُ عَلَي النَّارِ هُدًي ۝١٠
ayahs.tr: When he saw a fire and said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire; perhaps I can bring you a torch or find at the fire some guidance."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا͏ٓ اَتٰىهَا نُوْدِيَ يٰمُوْسٰي ۝١١ؕ
ayahs.tr: And when he came to it, he was called, "O Moses,

ayahs.ar: اِنِّيْٓ اَنَا رَبُّكَ فَاخْلَعْ نَعْلَيْكَۚ اِنَّكَ بِالْوَادِ الْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًي ۝١٢ؕ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, I am your Lord, so remove your sandals. Indeed, you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa.

ayahs.ar: وَاَنَا اخْتَرْتُكَ فَاسْتَمِعْ لِمَا يُوْحٰي ۝١٣
ayahs.tr: And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed [to you].

ayahs.ar: اِنَّنِيْٓ اَنَا اللّٰهُ لَا͏ٓ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا͏ٓ اَنَا فَاعْبُدْنِيْۙ وَاَقِمِ الصَّلٰوةَ لِذِكْرِيْ ۝١٤
ayahs.tr: Indeed, I am Allah. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ السَّاعَةَ اٰتِيَةٌ اَكَادُ اُخْفِيْهَا لِتُجْزٰي كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا تَسْعٰي ۝١٥
ayahs.tr: Indeed, the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives.

ayahs.ar: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنْهَا مَنْ لَّا يُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُ بِهَا وَاتَّبَعَ هَوٰىهُ فَتَرْدٰي ۝١٦
ayahs.tr: So do not let one avert you from it who does not believe in it and follows his desire, for you [then] would perish.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا تِلْكَ بِيَمِيْنِكَ يٰمُوْسٰي ۝١٧
ayahs.tr: And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ هِيَ عَصَايَۚ اَتَوَكَّو͏ٔ͏ُا عَلَيْهَا وَاَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلٰي غَنَمِيْ وَلِيَ فِيْهَا مَاٰرِبُ اُخْرٰي ۝١٨
ayahs.tr: He said, "It is my staff; I lean upon it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep and I have therein other uses."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اَلْقِهَا يٰمُوْسٰي ۝١٩
ayahs.tr: [Allah] said, "Throw it down, O Moses."

ayahs.ar: فَاَلْقٰىهَا فَاِذَا هِيَ حَيَّةٌ تَسْعٰي ۝٢٠
ayahs.tr: So he threw it down, and thereupon it was a snake, moving swiftly.

ayahs.ar: قَالَ خُذْهَا وَلَا تَخَفْࣟ سَنُعِيْدُهَا سِيْرَتَهَا الْاُوْلٰي ۝٢١
ayahs.tr: [Allah] said, "Seize it and fear not; We will return it to its former condition.

ayahs.ar: وَاضْمُمْ يَدَكَ اِلٰي جَنَاحِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَا࢜ءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوْ࢜ءٍ اٰيَةً اُخْرٰي ۝٢٢ۙ
ayahs.tr: And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease - another sign,

ayahs.ar: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنْ اٰيٰتِنَا الْكُبْرٰي ۝٢٣ۚ
ayahs.tr: That We may show you [some] of Our greater signs.

ayahs.ar: اِذْهَبْ اِلٰي فِرْعَوْنَ اِنَّهٗ طَغٰي ۝٢٤ࣖ
ayahs.tr: Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِيْ صَدْرِيْ ۝٢٥ۙ
ayahs.tr: [Moses] said, "My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance]
And ease for me my task

ayahs.ar: وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّنْ لِّسَانِيْ ۝٢٧ۙ
ayahs.tr: And untie the knot from my tongue

ayahs.ar: يَفْقَهُوْا قَوْلِيْ ۝٢٨ࣕ
ayahs.tr: That they may understand my speech.

ayahs.ar: وَاجْعَلْ لِّيْ وَزِيْرًا مِّنْ اَهْلِيْ ۝٢٩ۙ
ayahs.tr: And appoint for me a minister from my family -

ayahs.ar: هٰرُوْنَ اَخِي ۝٣٠ۙ
ayahs.tr: Aaron, my brother.

ayahs.ar: اشْدُدْ بِهٖٓ اَزْرِيْ ۝٣١ۙ
ayahs.tr: Increase through him my strength

ayahs.ar: وَاَشْرِكْهُ فِيْٓ اَمْرِيْ ۝٣٢ۙ
ayahs.tr: And let him share my task

ayahs.ar: كَيْ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيْرًا ۝٣٣ۙ
ayahs.tr: That we may exalt You much

ayahs.ar: وَّنَذْكُرَكَ كَثِيْرًا ۝٣٤ؕ
ayahs.tr: And remember You much.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّكَ كُنْتَ بِنَا بَصِيْرًا ۝٣٥
ayahs.tr: Indeed, You are of us ever Seeing."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ قَدْ اُوْتِيْتَ سُو͏ٔ͏ْلَكَ يٰمُوْسٰي ۝٣٦
ayahs.tr: [Allah] said, "You have been granted your request, O Moses.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَيْكَ مَرَّةً اُخْرٰٓي ۝٣٧ۙ
ayahs.tr: And We had already conferred favor upon you another time,

ayahs.ar: اِذْ اَوْحَيْنَا͏ٓ اِلٰٓي اُمِّكَ مَا يُوْحٰٓي ۝٣٨ۙ
ayahs.tr: When We inspired to your mother what We inspired,

ayahs.ar: اَنِ اقْذِفِيْهِ فِي التَّابُوْتِ فَاقْذِفِيْهِ فِي الْيَمِّ فَلْيُلْقِهِ الْيَمُّ بِالسَّاحِلِ يَاْخُذْهُ عَدُوٌّ لِّيْ وَعَدُوٌّ لَّهٗؕ وَاَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةً مِّنِّيْ࣢ۚ وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلٰي عَيْنِيْ ۝٣٩ۘ
ayahs.tr: [Saying], 'Cast him into the chest and cast it into the river, and the river will throw it onto the bank; there will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him.' And I bestowed upon you love from Me that you would be brought up under My eye.

ayahs.ar: اِذْ تَمْشِيْٓ اُخْتُكَ فَتَقُوْلُ هَلْ اَدُلُّكُمْ عَلٰي مَنْ يَّكْفُلُهٗؕ فَرَجَعْنٰكَ اِلٰٓي اُمِّكَ كَيْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ࣢ؕ وَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا فَنَجَّيْنٰكَ مِنَ الْغَمِّ وَفَتَنّٰكَ فُتُوْنًا࣢ࣞ فَلَبِثْتَ سِنِيْنَ فِيْٓ اَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ࣢ۙ ثُمَّ جِي͏ٔ͏ْتَ عَلٰي قَدَرٍ يّٰمُوْسٰي ۝٤٠
ayahs.tr: [And We favored you] when your sister went and said, 'Shall I direct you to someone who will be responsible for him?' So We restored you to your mother that she might be content and not grieve. And you killed someone, but We saved you from retaliation and tried you with a [severe] trial. And you remained [some] years among the people of Madyan. Then you came [here] at the decreed time, O Moses.

ayahs.ar: وَاصْطَنَعْتُكَ لِنَفْسِيْ ۝٤١ۚ
ayahs.tr: And I produced you for Myself.

ayahs.ar: اِذْهَبْ اَنْتَ وَاَخُوْكَ بِاٰيٰتِيْ وَلَا تَنِيَا فِيْ ذِكْرِيْ ۝٤٢ۚ
ayahs.tr: Go, you and your brother, with My signs and do not slacken in My remembrance.

ayahs.ar: اِذْهَبَا͏ٓ اِلٰي فِرْعَوْنَ اِنَّهٗ طَغٰي ۝٤٣ۚۖ
ayahs.tr: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.

ayahs.ar: فَقُوْلَا لَهٗ قَوْلًا لَّيِّنًا لَّعَلَّهٗ يَتَذَكَّرُ اَوْ يَخْشٰي ۝٤٤
ayahs.tr: And speak to him with gentle speech that perhaps he may be reminded or fear [Allah]."

ayahs.ar: قَالَا رَبَّنَا͏ٓ اِنَّنَا نَخَافُ اَنْ يَّفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَا͏ٓ اَوْ اَنْ يَّطْغٰي ۝٤٥
ayahs.tr: They said, "Our Lord, indeed we are afraid that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَا͏ٓ اِنَّنِيْ مَعَكُمَا͏ٓ اَسْمَعُ وَاَرٰي ۝٤٦
ayahs.tr: [Allah] said, "Fear not. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.

ayahs.ar: فَاْتِيٰهُ فَقُوْلَا͏ٓ اِنَّا رَسُوْلَا رَبِّكَ فَاَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِيْٓ اِسْرَا࢜ءِيْلَ࣢ۙ وَلَا تُعَذِّبْهُمْؕ قَدْ جِي͏ٔ͏ْنٰكَ بِاٰيَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّكَؕ وَالسَّلٰمُ عَلٰي مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الْهُدٰي ۝٤٧
ayahs.tr: So go to him and say, 'Indeed, we are messengers of your Lord, so send with us the Children of Israel and do not torment them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord. And peace will be upon he who follows the guidance.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا قَدْ اُوْحِيَ اِلَيْنَا͏ٓ اَنَّ الْعَذَابَ عَلٰي مَنْ كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلّٰي ۝٤٨
ayahs.tr: Indeed, it has been revealed to us that the punishment will be upon whoever denies and turns away.' "

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَمَنْ رَّبُّكُمَا يٰمُوْسٰي ۝٤٩
ayahs.tr: [Pharaoh] said, "So who is the Lord of you two, O Moses?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبُّنَا الَّذِيْٓ اَعْطٰي كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلْقَهٗ ثُمَّ هَدٰي ۝٥٠
ayahs.tr: He said, "Our Lord is He who gave each thing its form and then guided [it]."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ الْقُرُوْنِ الْاُوْلٰي ۝٥١
ayahs.tr: [Pharaoh] said, "Then what is the case of the former generations?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ عِلْمُهَا عِنْدَ رَبِّيْ فِيْ كِتٰبٍۚ لَا يَضِلُّ رَبِّيْ وَلَا يَنْسَي ۝٥٢ؗ
ayahs.tr: [Moses] said, "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record. My Lord neither errs nor forgets."

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيْ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْاَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَّسَلَكَ لَكُمْ فِيْهَا سُبُلًا وَّاَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَا࢜ءِ مَا࢜ءًؕ فَاَخْرَجْنَا بِهٖٓ اَزْوَاجًا مِّنْ نَّبَاتٍ شَتّٰي ۝٥٣
ayahs.tr: [It is He] who has made for you the earth as a bed [spread out] and inserted therein for you roadways and sent down from the sky, rain and produced thereby categories of various plants.

ayahs.ar: كُلُوْا وَارْعَوْا اَنْعَامَكُمْؕ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّاُولِي النُّهٰي ۝٥٤ࣖ
ayahs.tr: Eat [therefrom] and pasture your livestock. Indeed, in that are signs for those of intelligence.

ayahs.ar: مِنْهَا خَلَقْنٰكُمْ وَفِيْهَا نُعِيْدُكُمْ وَمِنْهَا نُخْرِجُكُمْ تَارَةً اُخْرٰي ۝٥٥
ayahs.tr: From the earth We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will extract you another time.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ اَرَيْنٰهُ اٰيٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَاَبٰي ۝٥٦
ayahs.tr: And We certainly showed Pharaoh Our signs - all of them - but he denied and refused.

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اَجِي͏ٔ͏ْتَنَا لِتُخْرِجَنَا مِنْ اَرْضِنَا بِسِحْرِكَ يٰمُوْسٰي ۝٥٧
ayahs.tr: He said, "Have you come to us to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses?

ayahs.ar: فَلَنَاْتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحْرٍ مِّثْلِهٖ فَاجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكَ مَوْعِدًا لَّا نُخْلِفُهٗ نَحْنُ وَلَا͏ٓ اَنْتَ مَكَانًا سُوًي ۝٥٨
ayahs.tr: Then we will surely bring you magic like it, so make between us and you an appointment, which we will not fail to keep and neither will you, in a place assigned."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ مَوْعِدُكُمْ يَوْمُ الزِّيْنَةِ وَاَنْ يُّحْشَرَ النَّاسُ ضُحًي ۝٥٩
ayahs.tr: [Moses] said, "Your appointment is on the day of the festival when the people assemble at mid-morning."

ayahs.ar: فَتَوَلّٰي فِرْعَوْنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيْدَهٗ ثُمَّ اَتٰي ۝٦٠
ayahs.tr: So Pharaoh went away, put together his plan, and then came [to Moses].

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَهُمْ مُّوْسٰي وَيْلَكُمْ لَا تَفْتَرُوْا عَلَي اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا فَيُسْحِتَكُمْ بِعَذَابٍۚ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنِ افْتَرٰي ۝٦١
ayahs.tr: Moses said to the magicians summoned by Pharaoh, "Woe to you! Do not invent a lie against Allah or He will exterminate you with a punishment; and he has failed who invents [such falsehood]."

ayahs.ar: فَتَنَازَعُوْٓا اَمْرَهُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ وَاَسَرُّوا النَّجْوٰي ۝٦٢
ayahs.tr: So they disputed over their affair among themselves and concealed their private conversation.

ayahs.ar: قَالُوْٓا اِنْ هٰذٰىنِ لَسٰحِرٰنِ يُرِيْدٰنِ اَنْ يُّخْرِجٰكُمْ مِّنْ اَرْضِكُمْ بِسِحْرِهِمَا وَيَذْهَبَا بِطَرِيْقَتِكُمُ الْمُثْلٰي ۝٦٣
ayahs.tr: They said, "Indeed, these are two magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic and do away with your most exemplary way.

ayahs.ar: فَاَجْمِعُوْا كَيْدَكُمْ ثُمَّ اي͏ٔ͏ْتُوْا صَفًّاۚ وَقَدْ اَفْلَحَ الْيَوْمَ مَنِ اسْتَعْلٰي ۝٦٤
ayahs.tr: So resolve upon your plan and then come [forward] in line. And he has succeeded today who overcomes."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوْا يٰمُوْسٰٓي اِمَّا͏ٓ اَنْ تُلْقِيَ وَاِمَّا͏ٓ اَنْ نَّكُوْنَ اَوَّلَ مَنْ اَلْقٰي ۝٦٥
ayahs.tr: They said, "O Moses, either you throw or we will be the first to throw."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ بَلْ اَلْقُوْاۚ فَاِذَا حِبَالُهُمْ وَعِصِيُّهُمْ يُخَيَّلُ اِلَيْهِ مِنْ سِحْرِهِمْ اَنَّهَا تَسْعٰي ۝٦٦
ayahs.tr: He said, "Rather, you throw." And suddenly their ropes and staffs seemed to him from their magic that they were moving [like snakes].

ayahs.ar: فَاَوْجَسَ فِيْ نَفْسِهٖ خِيْفَةً مُّوْسٰي ۝٦٧
ayahs.tr: And he sensed within himself apprehension, did Moses.

ayahs.ar: قُلْنَا لَا تَخَفْ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْاَعْلٰي ۝٦٨
ayahs.tr: Allah said, "Fear not. Indeed, it is you who are superior.

ayahs.ar: وَاَلْقِ مَا فِيْ يَمِيْنِكَ تَلْقَفْ مَا صَنَعُوْاؕ اِنَّمَا صَنَعُوْا كَيْدُ سٰحِرٍؕ وَلَا يُفْلِحُ السَّاحِرُ حَيْثُ اَتٰي ۝٦٩
ayahs.tr: And throw what is in your right hand; it will swallow up what they have crafted. What they have crafted is but the trick of a magician, and the magician will not succeed wherever he is."

ayahs.ar: فَاُلْقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًا قَالُوْٓا اٰمَنَّا بِرَبِّ هٰرُوْنَ وَمُوْسٰي ۝٧٠
ayahs.tr: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اٰمَنْتُمْ لَهٗ قَبْلَ اَنْ اٰذَنَ لَكُمْؕ اِنَّهٗ لَكَبِيْرُكُمُ الَّذِيْ عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحْرَۚ فَلَاُقَطِّعَنَّ اَيْدِيَكُمْ وَاَرْجُلَكُمْ مِّنْ خِلَافٍ وَّلَاُوصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ فِيْ جُذُوْعِ النَّخْلِؗ وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ اَيُّنَا͏ٓ اَشَدُّ عَذَابًا وَّاَبْقٰي ۝٧١
ayahs.tr: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic. So I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, and you will surely know which of us is more severe in [giving] punishment and more enduring."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوْا لَنْ نُّو͏ٔ͏ْثِرَكَ عَلٰي مَا جَا࢜ءَنَا مِنَ الْبَيِّنٰتِ وَالَّذِيْ فَطَرَنَا فَاقْضِ مَا͏ٓ اَنْتَ قَاضٍؕ اِنَّمَا تَقْضِيْ هٰذِهِ الْحَيٰوةَ الدُّنْيَا ۝٧٢ؕ
ayahs.tr: They said, "Never will we prefer you over what has come to us of clear proofs and [over] He who created us. So decree whatever you are to decree. You can only decree for this worldly life.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا͏ٓ اٰمَنَّا بِرَبِّنَا لِيَغْفِرَ لَنَا خَطٰيٰنَا وَمَا͏ٓ اَكْرَهْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنَ السِّحْرِؕ وَاللّٰهُ خَيْرٌ وَّاَبْقٰي ۝٧٣
ayahs.tr: Indeed, we have believed in our Lord that He may forgive us our sins and what you compelled us [to do] of magic. And Allah is better and more enduring."

ayahs.ar: اِنَّهٗ مَنْ يَّاْتِ رَبَّهٗ مُجْرِمًا فَاِنَّ لَهٗ جَهَنَّمَؕ لَا يَمُوْتُ فِيْهَا وَلَا يَحْيٰي ۝٧٤
ayahs.tr: Indeed, whoever comes to his Lord as a criminal - indeed, for him is Hell; he will neither die therein nor live.

ayahs.ar: وَمَنْ يَّاْتِهٖ مُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنًا قَدْ عَمِلَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَاُولٰ࢜ىِٕكَ لَهُمُ الدَّرَجٰتُ الْعُلٰي ۝٧٥ۙ
ayahs.tr: But whoever comes to Him as a believer having done righteous deeds - for those will be the highest degrees [in position]:

ayahs.ar: جَنّٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِيْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَاؕ وَذٰلِكَ جَزٰ࢜و͏ٔ͏ُا مَنْ تَزَكّٰي ۝٧٦ࣖ
ayahs.tr: Gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. And that is the reward of one who purifies himself.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ اَوْحَيْنَا͏ٓ اِلٰي مُوْسٰٓي࣢ۙ اَنْ اَسْرِ بِعِبَادِيْ فَاضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيْقًا فِي الْبَحْرِ يَبَسًاۙ لَّا تَخٰفُ دَرَكًا وَّلَا تَخْشٰي ۝٧٧
ayahs.tr: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]."

ayahs.ar: فَاَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ بِجُنُوْدِهٖ فَغَشِيَهُمْ مِّنَ الْيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمْ ۝٧٨ؕ
ayahs.tr: So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them,

ayahs.ar: وَاَضَلَّ فِرْعَوْنُ قَوْمَهٗ وَمَا هَدٰي ۝٧٩
ayahs.tr: And Pharaoh led his people astray and did not guide [them].

ayahs.ar: يٰبَنِيْٓ اِسْرَا࢜ءِيْلَ قَدْ اَنْجَيْنٰكُمْ مِّنْ عَدُوِّكُمْ وَوٰعَدْنٰكُمْ جَانِبَ الطُّوْرِ الْاَيْمَنَ وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَنَّ وَالسَّلْوٰي ۝٨٠
ayahs.tr: O Children of Israel, We delivered you from your enemy, and We made an appointment with you at the right side of the mount, and We sent down to you manna and quails,

ayahs.ar: كُلُوْا مِنْ طَيِّبٰتِ مَا رَزَقْنٰكُمْ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا فِيْهِ فَيَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبِيْۚ وَمَنْ يَّحْلِلْ عَلَيْهِ غَضَبِيْ فَقَدْ هَوٰي ۝٨١
ayahs.tr: [Saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you and do not transgress [or oppress others] therein, lest My anger should descend upon you. And he upon whom My anger descends has certainly fallen."

ayahs.ar: وَاِنِّيْ لَغَفَّارٌ لِّمَنْ تَابَ وَاٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا ثُمَّ اهْتَدٰي ۝٨٢
ayahs.tr: But indeed, I am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents and believes and does righteousness and then continues in guidance.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا͏ٓ اَعْجَلَكَ عَنْ قَوْمِكَ يٰمُوْسٰي ۝٨٣
ayahs.tr: [Allah] said, "And what made you hasten from your people, O Moses?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ هُمْ اُولَا࢜ءِ عَلٰٓي اَثَرِيْ وَعَجِلْتُ اِلَيْكَ رَبِّ لِتَرْضٰي ۝٨٤
ayahs.tr: He said, "They are close upon my tracks, and I hastened to You, my Lord, that You be pleased."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَاِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِكَ وَاَضَلَّهُمُ السَّامِرِيُّ ۝٨٥
ayahs.tr: [Allah] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Samiri has led them astray."

ayahs.ar: فَرَجَعَ مُوْسٰٓي اِلٰي قَوْمِهٖ غَضْبَانَ اَسِفًا࣢ۚ قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ اَلَمْ يَعِدْكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ وَعْدًا حَسَنًا࣢ؕ اَفَطَالَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْعَهْدُ اَمْ اَرَدْتُّمْ اَنْ يَّحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّكُمْ فَاَخْلَفْتُمْ مَّوْعِدِيْ ۝٨٦
ayahs.tr: So Moses returned to his people, angry and grieved. He said, "O my people, did your Lord not make you a good promise? Then, was the time [of its fulfillment] too long for you, or did you wish that wrath from your Lord descend upon you, so you broke your promise [of obedience] to me?"

ayahs.ar: قَالُوْا مَا͏ٓ اَخْلَفْنَا مَوْعِدَكَ بِمَلْكِنَا وَلٰكِنَّا حُمِّلْنَا͏ٓ اَوْزَارًا مِّنْ زِيْنَةِ الْقَوْمِ فَقَذَفْنٰهَا فَكَذٰلِكَ اَلْقَي السَّامِرِيُّ ۝٨٧ۙ
ayahs.tr: They said, "We did not break our promise to you by our will, but we were made to carry burdens from the ornaments of the people [of Pharaoh], so we threw them [into the fire], and thus did the Samiri throw."

ayahs.ar: فَاَخْرَجَ لَهُمْ عِجْلًا جَسَدًا لَّهٗ خُوَارٌ فَقَالُوْا هٰذَا͏ٓ اِلٰهُكُمْ وَاِلٰهُ مُوْسٰي࣢ فَنَسِيَ ۝٨٨ؕ
ayahs.tr: And he extracted for them [the statue of] a calf which had a lowing sound, and they said, "This is your god and the god of Moses, but he forgot."

ayahs.ar: اَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ اَلَّا يَرْجِعُ اِلَيْهِمْ قَوْلًا࣢ۙ وَّلَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ ضَرًّا وَّلَا نَفْعًا ۝٨٩ࣖ
ayahs.tr: Did they not see that it could not return to them any speech and that it did not possess for them any harm or benefit?

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ قَالَ لَهُمْ هٰرُوْنُ مِنْ قَبْلُ يٰقَوْمِ اِنَّمَا فُتِنْتُمْ بِهٖۚ وَاِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ الرَّحْمٰنُ فَاتَّبِعُوْنِيْ وَاَطِيْعُوْٓا اَمْرِيْ ۝٩٠
ayahs.tr: And Aaron had already told them before [the return of Moses], "O my people, you are only being tested by it, and indeed, your Lord is the Most Merciful, so follow me and obey my order."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوْا لَنْ نَّبْرَحَ عَلَيْهِ عٰكِفِيْنَ حَتّٰي يَرْجِعَ اِلَيْنَا مُوْسٰي ۝٩١
ayahs.tr: They said, "We will never cease being devoted to the calf until Moses returns to us."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يٰهٰرُوْنُ مَا مَنَعَكَ اِذْ رَاَيْتَهُمْ ضَلُّوْٓا ۝٩٢ۙ
ayahs.tr: [Moses] said, "O Aaron, what prevented you, when you saw them going astray,

ayahs.ar: اَلَّا تَتَّبِعَنِؕ اَفَعَصَيْتَ اَمْرِيْ ۝٩٣
ayahs.tr: From following me? Then have you disobeyed my order?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يَبْنَو͏ٔ͏ُمَّ لَا تَاْخُذْ بِلِحْيَتِيْ وَلَا بِرَاْسِيْۚ اِنِّيْ خَشِيْتُ اَنْ تَقُوْلَ فَرَّقْتَ بَيْنَ بَنِيْٓ اِسْرَا࢜ءِيْلَ وَلَمْ تَرْقُبْ قَوْلِيْ ۝٩٤
ayahs.tr: [Aaron] said, "O son of my mother, do not seize [me] by my beard or by my head. Indeed, I feared that you would say, 'You caused division among the Children of Israel, and you did not observe [or await] my word.' "

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكَ يٰسَامِرِيُّ ۝٩٥
ayahs.tr: [Moses] said, "And what is your case, O Samiri?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ بَصُرْتُ بِمَا لَمْ يَبْصُرُوْا بِهٖ فَقَبَضْتُ قَبْضَةً مِّنْ اَثَرِ الرَّسُوْلِ فَنَبَذْتُهَا وَكَذٰلِكَ سَوَّلَتْ لِيْ نَفْسِيْ ۝٩٦
ayahs.tr: He said, "I saw what they did not see, so I took a handful [of dust] from the track of the messenger and threw it, and thus did my soul entice me."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَاذْهَبْ فَاِنَّ لَكَ فِي الْحَيٰوةِ اَنْ تَقُوْلَ لَا مِسَاسَࣕ وَاِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًا لَّنْ تُخْلَفَهٗۚ وَانْظُرْ اِلٰٓي اِلٰهِكَ الَّذِيْ ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًاؕ لَنُحَرِّقَنَّهٗ ثُمَّ لَنَنْسِفَنَّهٗ فِي الْيَمِّ نَسْفًا ۝٩٧
ayahs.tr: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it into the sea with a blast.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّمَا͏ٓ اِلٰهُكُمُ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيْ لَا͏ٓ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَؕ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا ۝٩٨
ayahs.tr: Your god is only Allah, except for whom there is no deity. He has encompassed all things in knowledge."

ayahs.ar: كَذٰلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ اَنۢ͏ْبَا࢜ءِ مَا قَدْ سَبَقَۚ وَقَدْ اٰتَيْنٰكَ مِنْ لَّدُنَّا ذِكْرًا ۝٩٩ۖۚ
ayahs.tr: Thus, [O Muhammad], We relate to you from the news of what has preceded. And We have certainly given you from Us the Qur'an.

ayahs.ar: مَنْ اَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ فَاِنَّهٗ يَحْمِلُ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ وِزْرًا ۝١٠٠ۙ
ayahs.tr: Whoever turns away from it - then indeed, he will bear on the Day of Resurrection a burden,

ayahs.ar: خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهِؕ وَسَا࢜ءَ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ حِمْلًا ۝١٠١ۙ
ayahs.tr: [Abiding] eternally therein, and evil it is for them on the Day of Resurrection as a load -

ayahs.ar: يَّوْمَ يُنْفَخُ فِي الصُّوْرِ وَنَحْشُرُ الْمُجْرِمِيْنَ يَوْمَىِٕذٍ زُرْقًا ۝١٠٢ۚۖ
ayahs.tr: The Day the Horn will be blown. And We will gather the criminals, that Day, blue-eyed.

ayahs.ar: يَّتَخَافَتُوْنَ بَيْنَهُمْ اِنْ لَّبِثْتُمْ اِلَّا عَشْرًا ۝١٠٣
ayahs.tr: They will murmur among themselves, "You remained not but ten [days in the world]."

ayahs.ar: نَحْنُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُوْلُوْنَ اِذْ يَقُوْلُ اَمْثَلُهُمْ طَرِيْقَةً اِنْ لَّبِثْتُمْ اِلَّا يَوْمًا ۝١٠٤ࣖ
ayahs.tr: We are most knowing of what they say when the best of them in manner will say, "You remained not but one day."

ayahs.ar: وَيَسْـَٔلُوْنَكَ عَنِ الْجِبَالِ فَقُلْ يَنْسِفُهَا رَبِّيْ نَسْفًا ۝١٠٥ۙ
ayahs.tr: And they ask you about the mountains, so say, "My Lord will blow them away with a blast.

ayahs.ar: فَيَذَرُهَا قَاعًا صَفْصَفًا ۝١٠٦ۙ
ayahs.tr: And He will leave the earth a level plain;

ayahs.ar: لَّا تَرٰي فِيْهَا عِوَجًا وَّلَا͏ٓ اَمْتًا ۝١٠٧ؕ
ayahs.tr: You will not see therein a depression or an elevation."

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَىِٕذٍ يَّتَّبِعُوْنَ الدَّاعِيَ لَا عِوَجَ لَهٗۚ وَخَشَعَتِ الْاَصْوَاتُ لِلرَّحْمٰنِ فَلَا تَسْمَعُ اِلَّا هَمْسًا ۝١٠٨
ayahs.tr: That Day, everyone will follow [the call of] the Caller [with] no deviation therefrom, and [all] voices will be stilled before the Most Merciful, so you will not hear except a whisper [of footsteps].

ayahs.ar: يَوْمَىِٕذٍ لَّا تَنْفَعُ الشَّفَاعَةُ اِلَّا مَنْ اَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحْمٰنُ وَرَضِيَ لَهٗ قَوْلًا ۝١٠٩
ayahs.tr: That Day, no intercession will benefit except [that of] one to whom the Most Merciful has given permission and has accepted his word.

ayahs.ar: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ اَيْدِيْهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيْطُوْنَ بِهٖ عِلْمًا ۝١١٠
ayahs.tr: Allah knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, but they do not encompass it in knowledge.

ayahs.ar: وَعَنَتِ الْوُجُوْهُ لِلْحَيِّ الْقَيُّوْمِؕ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ حَمَلَ ظُلْمًا ۝١١١
ayahs.tr: And [all] faces will be humbled before the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. And he will have failed who carries injustice.

ayahs.ar: وَمَنْ يَّعْمَلْ مِنَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَهُوَ مُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنٌ فَلَا يَخٰفُ ظُلْمًا وَّلَا هَضْمًا ۝١١٢
ayahs.tr: But he who does of righteous deeds while he is a believer - he will neither fear injustice nor deprivation.

ayahs.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ اَنْزَلْنٰهُ قُرْاٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا وَّصَرَّفْنَا فِيْهِ مِنَ الْوَعِيْدِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُوْنَ اَوْ يُحْدِثُ لَهُمْ ذِكْرًا ۝١١٣
ayahs.tr: And thus We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur'an and have diversified therein the warnings that perhaps they will avoid [sin] or it would cause them remembrance.

ayahs.ar: فَتَعٰلَي اللّٰهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّۚ وَلَا تَعْجَلْ بِالْقُرْاٰنِ مِنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ يُّقْضٰٓي اِلَيْكَ وَحْيُهٗؗ وَقُلْ رَّبِّ زِدْنِيْ عِلْمًا ۝١١٤
ayahs.tr: So high [above all] is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth. And, [O Muhammad], do not hasten with [recitation of] the Qur'an before its revelation is completed to you, and say, "My Lord, increase me in knowledge."

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدْ عَهِدْنَا͏ٓ اِلٰٓي اٰدَمَ مِنْ قَبْلُ فَنَسِيَ وَلَمْ نَجِدْ لَهٗ عَزْمًا ۝١١٥ࣖ
ayahs.tr: And We had already taken a promise from Adam before, but he forgot; and We found not in him determination.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةِ اسْجُدُوْا لِاٰدَمَ فَسَجَدُوْٓا اِلَّا͏ٓ اِبْلِيْسَؕ اَبٰي ۝١١٦
ayahs.tr: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except Iblees; he refused.

ayahs.ar: فَقُلْنَا يٰٓاٰدَمُ اِنَّ هٰذَا عَدُوٌّ لَّكَ وَلِزَوْجِكَ فَلَا يُخْرِجَنَّكُمَا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ فَتَشْقٰي ۝١١٧
ayahs.tr: So We said, "O Adam, indeed this is an enemy to you and to your wife. Then let him not remove you from Paradise so you would suffer.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ لَكَ اَلَّا تَجُوْعَ فِيْهَا وَلَا تَعْرٰي ۝١١٨ۙ
ayahs.tr: Indeed, it is [promised] for you not to be hungry therein or be unclothed.

ayahs.ar: وَاَنَّكَ لَا تَظْمَو͏ٔ͏ُا فِيْهَا وَلَا تَضْحٰي ۝١١٩
ayahs.tr: And indeed, you will not be thirsty therein or be hot from the sun."

ayahs.ar: فَوَسْوَسَ اِلَيْهِ الشَّيْطٰنُ قَالَ يٰٓاٰدَمُ هَلْ اَدُلُّكَ عَلٰي شَجَرَةِ الْخُلْدِ وَمُلْكٍ لَّا يَبْلٰي ۝١٢٠
ayahs.tr: Then Satan whispered to him; he said, "O Adam, shall I direct you to the tree of eternity and possession that will not deteriorate?"

ayahs.ar: فَاَكَلَا مِنْهَا فَبَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْاٰتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخْصِفٰنِ عَلَيْهِمَا مِنْ وَّرَقِ الْجَنَّةِؗ وَعَصٰٓي اٰدَمُ رَبَّهٗ فَغَوٰي ۝١٢١ࣕۖ
ayahs.tr: And Adam and his wife ate of it, and their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And Adam disobeyed his Lord and erred.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ اجْتَبٰهُ رَبُّهٗ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ وَهَدٰي ۝١٢٢
ayahs.tr: Then his Lord chose him and turned to him in forgiveness and guided [him].

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اهْبِطَا مِنْهَا جَمِيْعًاۢ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّۚ فَاِمَّا يَاْتِيَنَّكُمْ مِّنِّيْ هُدًي࣢ۙ فَمَنِ اتَّبَعَ هُدَايَ فَلَا يَضِلُّ وَلَا يَشْقٰي ۝١٢٣
ayahs.tr: [Allah] said, "Descend from Paradise - all, [your descendants] being enemies to one another. And if there should come to you guidance from Me - then whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray [in the world] nor suffer [in the Hereafter].

ayahs.ar: وَمَنْ اَعْرَضَ عَنْ ذِكْرِيْ فَاِنَّ لَهٗ مَعِيْشَةً ضَنْكًا وَّنَحْشُرُهٗ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ اَعْمٰي ۝١٢٤
ayahs.tr: And whoever turns away from My remembrance - indeed, he will have a depressed life, and We will gather him on the Day of Resurrection blind."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ لِمَ حَشَرْتَنِيْٓ اَعْمٰي وَقَدْ كُنْتُ بَصِيْرًا ۝١٢٥
ayahs.tr: He will say, "My Lord, why have you raised me blind while I was [once] seeing?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ كَذٰلِكَ اَتَتْكَ اٰيٰتُنَا فَنَسِيْتَهَاۚ وَكَذٰلِكَ الْيَوْمَ تُنْسٰي ۝١٢٦
ayahs.tr: [Allah] will say, "Thus did Our signs come to you, and you forgot them; and thus will you this Day be forgotten."

ayahs.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِيْ مَنْ اَسْرَفَ وَلَمْ يُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنْۢ بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهٖؕ وَلَعَذَابُ الْاٰخِرَةِ اَشَدُّ وَاَبْقٰي ۝١٢٧
ayahs.tr: And thus do We recompense he who transgressed and did not believe in the signs of his Lord. And the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and more enduring.

ayahs.ar: اَفَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِّنَ الْقُرُوْنِ يَمْشُوْنَ فِيْ مَسٰكِنِهِمْؕ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّاُولِي النُّهٰي ۝١٢٨ࣖ
ayahs.tr: Then, has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them as they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs for those of intelligence.

ayahs.ar: وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ لَكَانَ لِزَامًا وَّاَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّي ۝١٢٩ؕ
ayahs.tr: And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, punishment would have been an obligation [due immediately], and [if not for] a specified term [decreed].

ayahs.ar: فَاصْبِرْ عَلٰي مَا يَقُوْلُوْنَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوْعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ غُرُوْبِهَاۚ وَمِنْ اٰنَا࢜ي͏ٔ͏ِ الَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْ وَاَطْرَافَ النَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرْضٰي ۝١٣٠
ayahs.tr: So be patient over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting; and during periods of the night [exalt Him] and at the ends of the day, that you may be satisfied.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ اِلٰي مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهٖٓ اَزْوَاجًا مِّنْهُمْ زَهْرَةَ الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا࣢ۙ لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيْهِؕ وَرِزْقُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ وَّاَبْقٰي ۝١٣١
ayahs.tr: And do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [some] categories of them, [its being but] the splendor of worldly life by which We test them. And the provision of your Lord is better and more enduring.

ayahs.ar: وَاْمُرْ اَهْلَكَ بِالصَّلٰوةِ وَاصْطَبِرْ عَلَيْهَاؕ لَا نَسْـَٔلُكَ رِزْقًاؕ نَحْنُ نَرْزُقُكَؕ وَالْعَاقِبَةُ لِلتَّقْوٰي ۝١٣٢
ayahs.tr: And enjoin prayer upon your family [and people] and be steadfast therein. We ask you not for provision; We provide for you, and the [best] outcome is for [those of] righteousness.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوْا لَوْلَا يَاْتِيْنَا بِاٰيَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّهٖؕ اَوَلَمْ تَاْتِهِمْ بَيِّنَةُ مَا فِي الصُّحُفِ الْاُوْلٰي ۝١٣٣
ayahs.tr: And they say, "Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?" Has there not come to them evidence of what was in the former scriptures?

ayahs.ar: وَلَوْ اَنَّا͏ٓ اَهْلَكْنٰهُمْ بِعَذَابٍ مِّنْ قَبْلِهٖ لَقَالُوْا رَبَّنَا لَوْلَا͏ٓ اَرْسَلْتَ اِلَيْنَا رَسُوْلًا فَنَتَّبِعَ اٰيٰتِكَ مِنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ نَّذِلَّ وَنَخْزٰي ۝١٣٤
ayahs.tr: And if We had destroyed them with a punishment before him, they would have said, "Our Lord, why did You not send to us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses before we were humiliated and disgraced?"

ayahs.ar: قُلْ كُلٌّ مُّتَرَبِّصٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوْاۚ فَسَتَعْلَمُوْنَ مَنْ اَصْحٰبُ الصِّرَاطِ السَّوِيِّ وَمَنِ اهْتَدٰي ۝١٣٥ࣖ
ayahs.tr: Say, "Each [of us] is waiting; so wait. For you will know who are the companions of the sound path and who is guided."
